data.name: Hiawathaland Transit
data.synopsis: Free route bus that stops at both colleges, Division Street, Target/Cub, and El Tequila/Culvers.

data.name: Ole Bikes
data.synopsis: Great green alternative, available for check-out through Rølvaag Library.

data.name: Campus-Go
data.synopsis: On-demand daytime transportation for students to volunteer work, medical appointments, pharmacy trips, or work locally, not intended for shopping or other personal trips. Call 507-301-4818 to schedule a ride.

data.name: Break Airport Shuttles
data.synopsis: Northfield Lines shuttle operates only immediately before and after break. You must buy tickets 48 hours in advance.

data.name: First Choice Shuttle
data.synopsis: Shuttle service to and from MSP airports, bus and train depots, local shuttle, medical appointments, casinos, and package delivery.

data.synopsis: View all available transportation options on the St. Olaf website.
